official_identity.distinct_ids_meaning: Separate official detail objects and stages; explicit reciprocal parent/substitute association and common HB 233 number establish the lineage. IDs alone do not establish two independent numbered bills for this row contract.

counterarguments: Original and substitute have distinct official IDs, sponsors, text and page statuses. A version-level database could retain both objects; an original-only HB 233 record would require its own disposition and cannot inherit the signature.

The independent packet interprets the distinct official objects as independent instruments. The existing state-policy row already uses the substitute URL, signed date, enacted substance and chapter; its grain is the bill lineage, not an original-only proposal. There is no separate receiving bill number or second independent adoption in these records.

The codebook expressly preserves incorporation into another bill; this record describes a substitute for the same numbered bill, not incorporation into a separately numbered receiving bill. The state-policy grain does not explicitly resolve every state substitute; this is an evidence-based interpretation, not an express Delaware-specific rule.
california_precedent: California successor-stage review concerns locally numbered ordinances and historical extension/approval, not a substitute print in a single bill lineage. It preserves uncertain enactment and endpoint and does not mandate splitting Delaware. Profile 1.0.4 policy successor events require distinct instruments and cannot self-link; no event proposed.
